records.text: The White House stopped responding after Owens asked whether the email itself was fake and copied Steven Cheung and the communications team.

appearances.snippet: We went back to them and said, just to be clear, are you saying this is a fake email? ... I'm CCing Steven Cheung. I'm CCing everybody on the comms team. ... And poof, like a ghost. We were left just hanging there.

verification.notes: The claim concerns a private exchange and alleged cessation of replies. Owens provides the only available account; no public correspondence or independent confirmation was found.
